## Change and purpose

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Distinguish proposed design from executed capabilities.

## Evidence and validation

List checks actually performed, results, and checks not performed. Include only public-safe evidence.

## Publication and attribution

- [ ] All changed files and new history reviewed for secrets and confidential content
- [ ] Original/licensed content only; synthetic examples labeled
- [ ] Personal GitHub authentication and author/committer attribution verified
- [ ] AI assistance disclosed
- [ ] Limitations and unimplemented capabilities stated accurately
- [ ] Human owner will review and merge; no direct push to main
